item.title: Come for the Ice Cream, Stay for the Library! (Wed, Sept 2, 2026, from 2–3:30 p.m).
item.description: NEW STUDENTS: You are invited to a fun, relaxed introduction to the RPI Libraries! Grab a bingo card and explore research help, interlibrary loan, study spaces, technology, the Student Success Center, and more. Complete your bingo card to enter to win raffle prizes from local restaurants and shops. Even better, the first 100 students will get free ice cream and a library goodie bag! Stop in, meet our friendly staff, discover everything the Libraries have to offer, and maybe walk away a winner!

item.title: RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series – September 2026
item.description: The RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series brings together faculty, researchers, and industry partners to share ideas, highlight collaborations, and advance semiconductor and microelectronics innovation. The seminar on September 15th, at the Albany NanoTech Complex, features Rena Huang (RPI) and Amit Dikshit (AIM Photonics) in two 45-min talks and a networking break. Faculty and students are invited, registration is required, transportation is possible. Follow link for more information.

item.title: Save the Date! TOPOS 2026 Music Festival | September 2-5
item.description: Date: Tuesday, June 2, 2026 12:00 AM - 1:00 AM - What does music know about us that we don’t yet know about ourselves? TOPOS returns as a space for gathering, inquiry, and discovery. Across four days of performances, live podcasts, film screenings, and conversation, the festival creates occasions for deepened listening and critical encounters: music as a means of articulating that which resists articulation. Mark your calendars now!

item.title: Black Atlas | Edward George, with Fred Moten
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 2, 2026 7:00 PM - Filmmaker Edward George is in Troy for the American premiere of Black Atlas, with author Fred Moten joining for the post-screening talk. Drawing from an archive of 3,000 images held by The Warburg Institute in London, George creates a new film that reanimates historical imagery through narration, sound, and montage. Followed by a conversation between George and scholar, NYU professor, Fred Moten. Part of TOPOS 2026. This one-night-only screening…

item.title: Division of Human Resources Professional Development Seminar- “RPI MAX: Setting Goals and Reviewing Results”
item.description: This seminar will establish the positive effect of transforming the traditional role of planner and evaluator solely from the people-leader to a shared responsibility between leader and direct report. Leaders will experience how to develop and use effective SMART goals to help them, and their employees track progress and accurately evaluate outcomes. In addition, the fundamentals of an impactful performance discussion and the three phased approach of RPI MAX will be explored.

item.title: 2026 Founders Award of Excellence Nominations Due
item.description:
Date: Saturday, August 29, 2026 (all day) - The Founders Award of Excellence was established in 1994 to honor students who embody the qualities of creativity, discovery, and leadership, and the values of pride and responsibility. The award includes a cash prize, a special certificate, and recognition by faculty, staff, and peers at the Honors Convocation ceremony. Nominations should be submitted via our Qualtrics Form (available in link) no later than Saturday, August 29.
